title: Hold My Boulder: a co-op game where you and your friends rescue a kidnapped boulder king (badly)
author: MorsDemigod
selftext:
King Goldie (a smug boulder with a moustache) has been kidnapped and locked in a castle. You and up to 3 friends are the Royal Haulage crew, the least qualified rescue team in the kingdom.



To get him back you:



• order siege gear, which gets delivered by trebuchet from very far away

• batter down gates while the servants try to hold them shut

• catapult each other over the walls

• grab the jailer's key and bust Goldie out

• shove the King through walls, roll him downhill, or give up and fire him home by catapult



Everything is physics, everything breaks, and nobody dies. Guards just go flying, and you just get knocked flat and get back up. It's built to be chaotic with friends, but it works solo too.



Side note: I made it pretty much entirely with Claude Code. I did the design and playtesting, and the AI did the coding. The hardest part was never the code. It was making it actually fun.



Coming to Steam eventually. Would love to hear what you think!
